QuestInfo.0: Training Instructor Kiku is ready to give you the details about your second training session.
QuestInfo.1: Now you have to eliminate #b#e20 Trained Attack Stirges#k#n in #bRecruit Training Grounds 2#k. So... much... work!
QuestInfo.2: You carried out your second training session with Kiku. Next up... more work!

0.0: Let's see what you've got, recruit. I'm jumping you up to flying monsters. Most recruits have a hard time adjusting to airborne foes. I'd like to see how you handle a pack of angry Stirges.

yes.0: The Trained Attack Stirges don't fly too far, but they can be a real bear to get a lock on. Go to #bRecruit Training Grounds 2#k and take out #e#b20 Trained Attack Stirges#n#k. The entrance to the training grounds is the same as before. Try not to get lost.

no.0: Don't just rush into it, you blockhead. Think before you act!

1.0: You did all right. Take a breather before we move on.

yes.0: I'm still working on the schedule. Come back later.
